description: Generate a study aid from a notebook’s sources: flashcards or a quiz. RPC-backed (no browser). Returns when generation completes.

focus.description: Optional focus prompt to steer the content.

language.description: Language of the generated study aid (BCP-47 code or language name). Defaults to NOTEBOOKLM_CONTENT_LANGUAGE, or English.

name: generate_study_aid

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
